content.short: World of Pirates is a NFT Battle Royal Chess TCG where players can influence the game direction and have impact on the world's problems.
content.description:
Our vision is to make the world a better place, by simply playing our game - World of Pirates, where the community of players stir the direction of our game universe. Our mission is to make players feel safe, respected, part of our community, to universally own their in-game assets and together change the world in a better place.

World of Pirates is battle royal chess trading card game where the players own the in-game assets, decide the game direction and help the world indirectly by buying POTM (Pawn of the Month) NFTs where the revenue is donate to an impact charity.

If you're the kind of gamer who likes to compete and strategize, boy we have a game for you!!

It incites you. Makes you think. Puts in game your pirates and navy NFT collection.

World of Pirates makes you belong to a greater purpose. Makes you to be part of a community. It gives you the power to decide where the game goes.

Join us!
